FROM `ecom_v1.customers` AS customer
WHERE customer.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND customer.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND customer.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT
  customer.segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer.customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM
  `ecom_v1.customers` AS customer
JOIN
  `ecom_v1.dim_date` AS date_table
  ON customer.signup_date = date_table.date_key
WHERE
  date_table.year = 2024
  AND date_table.quarter <= 3
  AND customer.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1;
